resources.string: Cannot reach the PS5 Cafe server — retrying in %1$d s
Connecting to the PS5 Cafe server…
Press OK to retry now. Hold BACK for 3 seconds to open setup.
This TV screen is not configured yet
Set the server, station and screen key with the ADB command in android/tv-companion/README.md, or use the setup screen.
Android System WebView is not available on this TV
The screen page cannot be shown without it. Error: %1$s
Copy these values from the dashboard\'s Device Settings page for this TV. The screen URL has the form <server>/#/screen/<station>?k=<key>.
Saved: nothing yet. This TV is not configured.
Server origin, http or https with no path. Example: http://192.168.100.65:5173
Station ID: lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Example: ps5-03
Screen key. Leave empty to keep the saved key (it is never shown here).
Try to open the screen after the TV boots (best effort; often blocked on Android 10+)

Holding BACK for 3 seconds opens this page. That is a staff convenience, not a security boundary: HOME, INPUT, the TV\'s own buttons, a reboot or the PS5 itself can still take the TV away from this app. Nothing in this app locks the TV.

Physical-test evidence only. Record what you see in docs/HARDWARE_LIMITATIONS.md. Nothing on this screen is a lock. The app cannot see what an HDMI input shows, so a switch result here only means Android accepted the request: look at the TV and write down what actually happened.
TV inputs that accept a passthrough switch request
TvInputManager reported no passthrough (HDMI) inputs. See the report below for the reason.
Report written to logcat. Run: adb logcat -s PS5CafeDiag
Keeps the remaining-time box running over the TV picture.
Shows remaining session time over the TV picture. Informational only; not a lock.
Timer overlay: "Display over other apps" is GRANTED. %1$s

Timer overlay: "Display over other apps" is NOT granted, so the countdown box cannot appear. Grant it from the computer: adb shell appops set com.ps5cafe.tvcompanion SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow (pm grant does not work for this permission). %1$s
Overlay test running for 10 s. Switch the TV to the PS5 input now and look at the top-right corner. Record whether the box is visible on top of the game picture.
Overlay test not started: the permission is missing or Android refused to start the service. See adb logcat -s PS5CafeDiag.
